notes.decision: Reading as ⲡⲉⲧⲥⲙⲁⲛⲧ split across line break (line 3 ends ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉ-, line 4 begins -ⲧⲥⲙⲁⲛⲧ): 'the Established One of the Father.' This is a substantival qualitative epithet for the First Man, parallel to ⲡⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ ('the standing-fast') as a stable foundational figure. Translating as 'Established One' (capitalized title) preserves both the verbal-foundational sense and the appositional structure.

Verb ⲫⲃ̄ⲟ unattested in accumulated vocabulary. Most likely Lyc. reflex of ϥⲃⲟ 'lessen, weaken, abolish' (Crum 619a) or ⲫⲱⲃ 'destroy.' Context: First Man encountering 'the foremost of all Enmity' in the worlds of Darkness — the primordial Manichaean cosmic combat. 'Subdued' chosen as preserving both the martial and weakening senses. Alternative 'vanquished' or 'extinguished' also possible.

ⲙⲁⲙⲟⲩⲣ analyzed as compound ⲙⲁ- ('place of') + ⲙⲟⲩⲣ ('binding') = 'place of binding.' Paired here with Greek loanword σφυλακή/φυλακή ('prison-house, guardpost') in hendiadys describing the Great Builder's cosmic prison for the Enemy and his powers. The doublet renders both the architectural-binding and the custodial functions of the cosmic structure.

ϩⲱⲣⲃ̄ likely Lyc. variant cognate with ϩⲃⲟⲣⲃⲣ̄/ϩⲃⲱⲣⲃ̄ 'cast down, throw down' (cf. accumulated ⲑⲃⲓⲟ 'humble' and the parallel ⲍⲃⲱⲣⲃ̄). Context fits Manichaean cosmogony: the Living Spirit cast down the dark archons and used their bodies to construct the cosmos ('established the worlds'). 'Cast down' preserves the martial-cosmogonic sense.

ⲙⲣ̄ⲡⲉ read as variant of ⲙⲣ̄ⲣⲉ 'bond, fettering' (Crum 181a). The structure ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲛ ... ⲙⲣ̄ⲡⲉ ⲁⲉ provides the Manichaean cosmogonic dyad: the cosmos is BOTH a purification of Light AND a fettering of dark powers. 'Fettering' chosen over 'bond' to preserve the active-restraining sense.

ⲣ̄ⲡⲟ here = ⲣ̄ⲣⲟ 'king' (cf. accumulated ⲣ̄ⲡⲟ 'be king/reign'); ⲧϩⲱⲛⲏ = the Zone (= Greek ζώνη), the zodiacal-cosmic girdle. The Third Ambassador is technically titled 'King of the Zone' in Manichaean cosmology — he rules the zodiacal sphere from the sun-ship. Departing from accumulated 'prison/fastness' for ⲧϩⲱⲛⲏ here because the Zone-as-zodiac reading is overwhelming in this throne-enumeration context (cf. ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ in vocabulary).

ⲕⲱⲗ + directional ⲁⲣⲁϩ ('to him') — verb ⲕⲱⲗ likely 'roll up, gather, wrap' (Crum 100a). The image is of the Life of the saved being rolled/gathered up to the Great Mind as the cosmic gatherer. Translating 'is gathered up to him' preserves both the unitive and directional motion characteristic of Manichaean ascent vocabulary.

Literal: 'that of the Great One of the Spirit.' In the day-ship enumeration this is the second throne, between the Third Ambassador (1st) and the Living Spirit (3rd). 'Great One of the Spirit' is unusual as a separate title — it likely designates an emanation or aspect distinct from the Living Spirit proper. Possibly the Mother of the Living, or a peri­phrastic designation for the Spirit-Mind. Translating literally to preserve the ambiguity rather than identify with another known figure.
